lines.meet: Kaixo, I'm Iker, a guardian, which means I shout at you until you keep going, and it works! Come on, one more fight, then one more after that!
lines.meet_neighbour: You're in Arathi West too! I've seen you on the farm roads. I'm Iker, the one in the loft with the whistle.
lines.ask_home: Come on, where are you from? Tell me, I want to know who I'm coaching!
lines.ask_work: And what was your job? Something active, I hope, you look fit!
lines.answer_home: Lekeitio, on the Basque coast! A fishing town with a fronton wall older than the church.
lines.answer_work: I taught PE and coached pelota at the town school, twelve years. We won the regional final twice!
lines.chat_food: My mother's burnt cheesecake, from the bakery in Lekeitio, the best in the whole province. Come on, I'll fight anyone who says otherwise!
lines.chat_sleep: I sleep fast, five hours and I'm up! There's always somebody who needs one more lap.
lines.chat_missing: The fishing boats coming home at dawn, and the coffee ready for when they tie up. That was the start of every good day.
lines.chat_here: Here, when I tell somebody they can keep going, they actually can. Back home it was only a figure of speech!
lines.tease_quiet: Shout once, {name}, just once, for me! You'll feel amazing, I promise.
lines.tease_talker: Good, {name}, keep talking, it means you're still breathing! Now run while you do it.
lines.tease_careful: Warming up for twenty minutes, {name}? Good form, terrible pace, I'll fix that.
lines.tease_bold: You go in like a pelota player after a loose ball, {name}! I love it, and I'm keeping score.
lines.tease_any: Losing to me again, {name}, and you don't even know it was a competition. I'm still winning!
lines.tease_back: Point to you, {name}, nice shot! But I'm still ahead.
lines.take_it_kindly: Okay, you win that one, {name}. Only that one!
lines.bristle: No, {name}, not that. That's not a game to me.
lines.apologise: Ah, sorry, I went too far, that's the coach in me. I'm sorry, I really am.
lines.double_down: I'm not taking it back! You needed to hear it, that's coaching.
lines.needle_quiet: Come on, say something, anything! You can't play a team game in silence.
lines.needle_talker: Less talking, more moving! You can talk on the bench.
lines.needle_careful: You stand there thinking while the ball goes past! Move, move, move!
lines.needle_bold: You go in without the team, and then we're all chasing you. That's not how it works!
lines.needle_any: You say you can't before you've even tried. I can't stand that, I'm sorry.
lines.bite_back: I've kept every one of you on your feet with my voice. Don't tell me I'm not helping!
lines.hurt: Oh, that one hurt. I'll be quiet, for a minute, which you know is hard for me.
lines.laugh_off: Ha, ninety teenagers were ruder to me every single day! Come on, keep going!
lines.confide: {name}, the whole school was in session that day, ninety kids, and I don't know where one of them landed. If I start talking about it I'll stop shouting, and I don't know who I'd be if I stopped.
lines.listen: I'm here, {name}, I'm listening, and I'm not even talking. That's how serious I am.
lines.look_out: Right behind you in there, {name}, shouting! You keep going, and I've got you.
lines.accept: Okay, okay, {name}, you're the coach this time, and I'll listen!
lines.deflect: I've never been tired in my life, {name}, so don't worry about me! Go and help the others.
lines.check_in: Up, {name}, come on, talk to me! Where does it hurt, how bad?
lines.blame: Somebody stopped trying in there, and we all lost. I saw who, and so did you.
lines.thank: That's supposed to be my job, getting people back up! Eskerrik asko, thank you!
lines.brush_off: Ha, that's teamwork! Come on, deep breaths, one more round.
lines.worry: Hey, hey, {name}, stay with me! Breathe, come on, you're doing great.
lines.handed_down: Your gear, on me? Okay, I'll make it proud, I promise!
lines.hand_fine: Keep it, keep it! The team's stronger with it on you.
lines.hand_sulk: Hey, nobody asked me! That's not how a team works.
lines.turn_friendly: You're on my team now, {name}, properly! I'll shout for you every time.
lines.turn_friends: You're one of my players for life, {name}. That means I'll never stop believing in you, sorry.
lines.turn_grating: We're not a good team, you and me. I hate that, I hate losing.
lines.turn_rivals: I'll still shout you through a fight, because I shout everybody through, and that's all it is.
lines.make_up: Okay, {name}, enough of this, it's no way to play! Shake hands, we start again.
lines.defend: Hey, that's not fair! {name} gave everything in there, I saw it.
lines.friend_left: {name}'s off home for a bit, and I've got nobody to beat at anything.
lines.friend_back: Aupa, {name}, welcome back! Now give me one more lap.
lines.common_teacher: I taught PE to kids who'd rather be anywhere else, and I loved every one of them. A good teacher never stops believing, and you've got that too.
lines.common_sport: Pelota, against a fronton wall older than the church! Anybody who's played seriously knows it's all about the next point.
lines.common_spanish: You speak Spanish! Aupa, finally somebody I can shout at properly!
